gen-dafont-dogica-gf-suwannaphum: Heavy, wide, unmistakable. Dogica spaces its letters far apart with curves left open at the ends, while Suwannaphum answers in a serif with a high, dignified lowercase.
gen-dafont-dogica-inter: Commanding from the first word, Dogica stretches wide with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, and Inter follows in a smooth sans. Their gap is the draw.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One brings a literary, dignified classic serif with shallow ascenders and a tall middle band, set under Early GameBoy's playful, stretched-out letters. It stays easy going on and on.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-glegoo: Playful up top, refined below: Early GameBoy spreads wide with a skyward x-height, while Glegoo's serif keeps its curves wide open. That mix of toy and editorial is the draw.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-hanuman: Hanuman reads traditional and refined, with a high-waisted lowercase. Under Early GameBoy's stretched, playful capitals, this classic serif would carry a page with steady, unhurried grace.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-kadwa: Early GameBoy is spaced wide and open, with a gently thinned g and sturdy bowls, and Kadwa sits beneath as a classic serif with a large x-height. Playful meets editorial, politely.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text reads literary and dignified, its curved letters entered through generous strokes and its lowercase filling most of the height. Early GameBoy is best at commanding, slightly lively display lines, while Noticia Text is best at carrying the classic serif text that follows.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-piazzolla: Wide, open tracking with a skyward x-height gives Early GameBoy its playful swagger over Piazzolla. That classic serif, with its lowercase nearly matching capitals, keeps a long page authoritative.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-scope-one: Early GameBoy stretches its letters wide with modest contrast you only notice up close, over Scope One's serif with stubby ascenders and a big x-height. Shrink that heading and its swagger fades.
gen-dafont-early-gameboy-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px is bookish and dignified, with big open counters in its tall a, e and s. Early GameBoy supplies the playful, wide-set heading energy, and Slabo 13px settles the text serif beneath it.
